| Track | Shellac release(s) that feature John Coltrane | Writer credit on the track (source) |

| **Oo‑la‑la** | “Coast To Coast / Oo‑la‑la” (France, 22672511) | “Written‑By – Gillespie, Acea, Williams” – *Discogs release 22672511* |

| **Tally‑Ho** | “Tally‑Ho / I Can’t Remember” (US, 14669433) | “Written‑By – Dizzy Gillespie” – *Discogs release 14669433* |

**Notes**

* The four shellac releases listed above are the only releases for which we have both (1) a confirmed appearance of John Coltrane in the personnel credits and (2) documented track‑level writer credits for Dizzy Gillespie.
* Other shellac versions of the same releases (e.g., UK or other country pressings) exist (for example the UK‑issued “Tin Tin Daeo / Birks Works” 9416714), but their individual page data do not provide explicit writer‑credit information, so those releases are not included in the definitive list.
* No other Dizzy Gillespie shellac record featuring John Coltrane with explicit writer credits for Gillespie appears in the available Discogs data. If additional releases are discovered, the list would need to be updated accordingly.
